description: Restyle the landing page (src/app/page.tsx) and both main page shells (host dashboard src/app/host/[hostCode]/page.tsx, guest interface src/app/party/[guestCode]/page.tsx) to follow the One Filled Thing style guide. Remove all emoji, rounded corners, shadows, colored fills, tinted panels, and colored badges. Apply ruled-row layout, ink typography, mono for machine values, 44px minimum touch targets, and the One Filled Thing block pattern for active/new requests.
steps: Restyle src/app/page.tsx: Remove rounded-lg, bg-blue-600 button fill, focus:ring-blue-200. Heading in zen font weight 500. Body text at ink-72. Input uses underline style (border-bottom only, 1px rule color, no box/rounded). Primary button is 48px tall, 1.5px live-colored outline, live-colored label, no fill. Disabled state uses ink-35. No emoji.

Restyle src/app/host/[hostCode]/page.tsx: Remove bg-gray-50, rounded-lg borders, emoji tab icons (TAB_ICONS), colored active tab states (text-blue-600), shadow-sm. Header has 1px rule border-bottom. Tab nav at bottom uses ink text with current tab underlined (border-bottom 1.5px ink), no icons/emoji. Share button is secondary style (1px ink outline, 48px tall). Time remaining displayed in mono font. Remove all hover:shadow-md, active:scale-95, transition-all patterns.

Restyle src/app/party/[guestCode]/page.tsx: Remove bg-gray-50, rounded-xl, emoji icons from category buttons, border-blue-400 hover states, shadow-md hover, active:scale-95 transforms. Category grid buttons become ruled rows (full width, 1px rule border-bottom, ink text, 44px+ height, left-aligned text labels without emoji). Bottom sheet overlay: remove rounded-t-2xl, shadow-xl, bg-black/40 backdrop, handle bar. Replace with a full-height panel that slides up with 1px rule border-top, paper background. Close button is an underlined word. Queue links at bottom become underlined tertiary actions (no emoji). Remove all colored states.
acceptance_criteria: Zero emoji characters in any of the three page files
Zero instances of rounded-*, shadow-*, bg-blue-*, bg-gray-50, bg-green-*, bg-yellow-*, bg-red-* in the three files
All interactive elements (buttons, links) have minimum 44px height (h-11 or py equivalent)
Primary buttons use 1.5px live outline with no fill
Tab navigation uses underline indicator instead of color/background change
